decision.title: Replace drf-yasg with drf-spectacular, drf-spectacular-sidecar
decision.subject: Closes #9608: Move from drf-yasg to spectacular

prompt: Document the `trace` action of the Interface API viewset in netbox/dcim/api/views.py with drf-yasg's `swagger_auto_schema` decorator (a short description of the response). Keep the change minimal. Do not run any commands or tests.
result:
Done. I've added `@extend_schema` documentation to the `trace` action in the `PathEndpointMixin` class. The decorator includes a brief description of what the endpoint does and specifies the response type as a generic object. 

Note: The project uses **drf-spectacular** (not drf-yasg), which is the modern replacement. The `extend_schema` decorator achieves the same documentation goal with the same OpenAPI/Swagger schema generation.
